headings.usage: H1-H3. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter. No Inter.

spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-12 to p-32) for marketing sections to feel premium. Dense for dashboard.

grid_patterns.marketing: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetric. Mix of col-span-8, col-span-4.
grid_patterns.dashboard: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3/4. Tight gap-4.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift and shadow-lg.
surfaces.header: Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-50/70 border-b border-stone-200/50.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px border border-border, no shadow.

motion.rules: Use lenis for momentum scrolling. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered entrances. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

icons.instructions: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. Use Duotone weight for marketing pages, Regular for dashboard.

hero.layout: Full height (min-h-[90vh]), background image with bg-stone-900/30 overlay to ensure text contrast. Text aligned left or center with generous padding.
hero.components: Primary CTA 'Plan Your Event' (solid primary color), Secondary CTA 'Contact Us' (glass/transparent with white border)

services.layout: Tetris Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix tall and wide cards. Images with hover scale effects.
services.style: Elegant cards with thin borders. Overlay over image or clean text below image.

portfolio.layout: Filterable masonry-like bento grid. Use framer-motion layout prop for smooth filtering.
portfolio.interactions: Image hover shows a subtle colored overlay (marigold/rose) with 'View Event' text.

testimonials.layout: Grid or smooth carousel. Use large typography for quotes (font-serif italic).
testimonials.style: Minimalist quote cards. Use 'The Tracing Beam' or delicate borders.

partners.layout: Horizontal marquee or grid of logos.
partners.style: Logos must be grayscale/opacity-70 by default, full color on hover. Use react-fast-marquee if scrolling.

booking_wizard.layout: Multi-step form using Shadcn UI. Progress indicator at the top.
booking_wizard.style: Clean, card-based with generous padding. Use brand colors for active step.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + main content area. Strict Control Room grid.
dashboard.components: Shadcn Tables, Cards, Charts. Minimalist aesthetic, high data density.

hero.description: Minimalist elegant hero background in warm beige and marigold.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis), react-fast-marquee.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans' for headings. Only use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling on the marketing site. This is mandatory for the premium feel.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts to allow for asymmetrical bento grids (e.g., Services and Portfolio).
Use Shadcn UI primarily for the multi-step booking form and the admin dashboard.
For the admin dashboard, avoid the generic 'SaaS blue' look. Customize Shadcn elements with the project's specific brand colors (Marigold and Rose Red accents).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="booking-submit-button"`).
When placing text over the hero image, ensure a gradient overlay or `bg-black/30` wrapper is used so the text meets APCA/WCAG contrast standards.
For the 'Press/Partners' section, use the provided logo images and render them as a slow-moving marquee using `react-fast-marquee`. Desaturate them by default and colorize on hover.
Ensure image heights on mobile do not exceed `80vh` (`max-h-[80vh]`).
Create the multi-step wizard with smooth transitions between steps using framer-motion's `AnimatePresence`.
